policy: Implement the issue's specification in /testbed. You may inspect repository files and tests, edit implementation files, and run local commands. interface: Use shell(command) for local work. Each shell call starts in the qualified task environment. Use concise, targeted commands and test output to keep observations manageable. Shell tests provide debugging observations; they do not submit your work for scoring. After a candidate repair, call submit() to score the current files and receive feedback. A passing scored submission ends the run. Use finish(outcome, report, evidence) to end, with outcome 'blocked' or 'incomplete'. A final response without tools also ends the run. All commands must be self-contained; background processes are stopped after each command. No private reasoning is required.
